binaryNamespaces.rule: IDs are scoped to their parent container and product; do not move existing upstream values. Before upgrading the pinned Core baseline, scan for upstream collisions and block if a reserved value is occupied.

jc.default: omit; preserve the existing four encoded values
jc.unknown: Reject as unsupported in new conversion paths; never coerce to both or justify.

booleanEncoding.explicitFalse: encode 0; do not collapse to absent

characterIndentEncoding.twipFallback: coexist without overwriting raw character values

permission.writeRule: write only the standard spelling; retain field presence and values; do not inject identity, Space policy, or dynamic allow/deny state

lineSpacing.rule: preserve unit and raw integer; exactly one alternative per value; conflicting dual input is unsupported and must not be silently normalized

textDirection.rule: preserve direction token; eaVert keeps CJK upright and must not be implemented as character rotation

worksheetPicture.sharedMedia: allowed; resolve every sheet reference independently

history.coreBehavior: consume the resulting existing Picture data; do not parse or invent a C++ History action

sheet.print: Native SDKJS pagination and CPdfPrinter drawForPrint path must render the background on every printed page with clipping, scaling, alpha, shared-media and missing-image behavior checked. Picture29 codec support alone is not print support.

imageFailure.legacyDefault: tolerant for all existing ABI entrypoints
imageFailure.strictOptIn: explicit versioned policy selected by X2T conversion task and passed through PdfFile to graphics

resultCodesV1.1: image command failed: missing/decode/renderer returned anything other than S_OK
resultCodesV1.4: invalid policy version or struct size

imageFailure.propagation: first error stops conversion; CPdfFile returns failure; X2T returns the existing AVS_FILEUTILS_ERROR_CONVERT class and does not publish a successful candidate

abi.additive: fixed-width POD policy/result with size and version fields plus additive V1 entrypoints; no new virtual methods or data members

requiredReceipt: WASM/loader SHA256 or explicit not-required reason
target Core patch-set and DLL hashes
runtimeInputs.consumer: Core accepts these as locked product inputs; it does not fork or rebuild the product SDKJS. Browser WASM is owned by the product SDKJS build. A changed C++ bridge signature, feature struct, or ABI requires a new bridge/WASM loader artifact and matching receipt.

compatibilityMatrix.expected: old documents only; native print gains only separately verified existing Picture29 support
deny feature editing/materialization; old Core loses Word tags 200-209
deny feature materialization; old Core codec is lossy for new Word tags
legacy regression only; old JS does not implement new layout/print
read-only legacy/new-native route only after input-profile proof; no old-browser save of new Word BIN
editing may be isolated for codec tests; disable feature PDF/print and mixed-session collaboration
candidate full feature route after all three profiles and end-to-end acceptance pass
